name: Skyranger 30 (Rheinmetall)
description: 30x173 mm KCE-ABM revolver cannon with AHEAD programmable airburst on a 360-degree turret with organic AESA radar and EO/IR. Effective to 3 km. NATO mobile C-UAS.

minRangeM.condition: minimum engagement range — no public figure; representative close-in limit for a programmable airburst round that must be fuze-set at the muzzle and needs flight time before the burst point

maxRangeM.condition: effective range up to 3000 m with the gun

maxAltitudeFt.condition: engagement altitude ceiling — UNKNOWN. Rheinmetall and secondary reporting describe 'low-altitude threats' and a large elevation span but publish no ceiling.

engageTimeS.condition: assignment-to-effect time — DERIVED, not published. Arithmetic: 30x173 mm airburst projectile muzzle velocity is of order 1,000 m/s, so 3,000 m / 1,000 m/s = 3 s time of flight. Add about 5 s for turret slew, track settling and fuze programming: 3 + 5 = 8 s.

pk.condition: single-shot probability of kill — UNKNOWN as a number. Rheinmetall claims 'an extremely high probability of hit against micro-drones' from AHEAD programmable airburst but publishes no figure. 0.8 is a representative planning value only, NOT tested performance. Note that a gun 'shot' here means a programmed burst, not a single projectile.
pk.source: Germany To Bet Big On Skyranger Gun System To Address Growing Drone Threat

magazineSize.condition: 252 rounds of 30 mm ready to fire
magazineSize.note: Inventory records 300 ready rounds in the turret (300 rounds); the seed value is kept

salvoCooldownS.condition: salvo cooldown — no public figure; representative re-slew and re-track interval for a revolver cannon on a stabilised turret

dispersionMils.note: Planning factor: no vendor and no open source publishes a round-to-round dispersion for this gun. 1.0 mil at 1 sigma is the planning value for a stabilised automatic cannon, and it is a factor, not a measurement. The Rheinmetall brochure claims best-of-class accuracy and publishes no dispersion figure.

fireControlErrorMils.note: Planning factor: 1.0 mil at 1 sigma aim error for a radar-directed, fully stabilised mount. The GCC30 fire control and the AESA tracking radar carry no published error budget.

burstRounds.note: Planning factor: one second of automatic fire at the nominal 1,200 rounds/min rate in the brochure. Rheinmetall publishes no burst length for the air-burst engagement.

rateOfFireRpm.condition: nominal rate of fire 1,200 rounds/min; rapid single shot mode is 200 rounds/min

muzzleVelocityMps.condition: mean muzzle velocity ABM (V0) 1,075 m/s, the same figure as full calibre
